hook: A conjectured edge-coloring formula for odd-fold graph covers fails, and the Petersen graph breaks it.
hook_turn: and the Petersen graph breaks it.
summary: The authors prove a sharp upper bound on the fewest colors needed to edge-color an odd-fold cover of a graph. They build counterexamples from cubic graphs, including the Petersen graph, to a published conjecture, and give polynomial-time algorithms. The results cover odd fold numbers only.
title: Edge-coloring spectra of odd-fold graph covers and counterexamples to a conjecture
